correctness.rationale: The full 10-vertex graph yields exactly 90 disconnected-triple complement facets and 937 nonempty faces. Independently reconstructed its 4,440 Hasse covers and the specified greedy vertex-toggle Morse matching: 465 pairs with one critical 0-cell and six critical 6-cells; direct reversal-and-topological-sort verifies no directed cycle. This gives a non-equivariant wedge of six 6-spheres, hence concentrated homology. An independent signed fixed-face Lefschetz enumeration across ALL 120 permutations gave traces (6,0,-2,0,0,0,1); the algebraic character identity for the exterior square of the four-dimensional permutation augmentation module gives the same values, and class-size squared sum 120 makes it irreducible. The finite exhaustive enumeration is a proof for this exact graph, not a general-graph theorem.
correctness.risk: Finite graph only; no integral module identification or equivariant homotopy equivalence.
